/* CSS placed here will affect users of the Vector skin */
div#mw-panel div.portal {margin:0;}
div#mw-panel div.portal.first div.body ul li {line-height: 1.7em; }
div#mw-panel div.portal.first div.body .thumb .thumbcaption {margin:0;font-size:70%;}
div#mw-panel div.portal.first div.tright {padding:0;margin:0;}
div#mw-panel div.portal.first div.magnify {display:none;}
div#mw-panel div.portal.first div.body {margin:0;}
